metadataRaw.title: How to DECOMPRESS Your Upper Back at Home
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe goes over how to decompress your upper back at home. These decompression traction based exercises may give upper back pain relief in as little as 30 SECONDS!

These exercises are going to focus on pulling motions, or spinal decompression TRACTION, to help open up the joints of the thoracic spine, or upper back.

A lot of this pain is caused from strain and sprain in the upper back that can build pressure into the thoracic spinal discs. The safe way to fix this is to reduce the pressure within the spinal discs through traction exercises, which will help decompress the disc. 

That way bulging material is brought back into the spinal disc, off any pinched nerves, which allows you to HEAL and have less pain.

These exercises are SAFE, effective, don't require any special equipment, and can be done in the comfort of your own home.

WATCH NOW and decompress your upper back and get feeling instant relief!
